title: Color Palette Advisor
description: Proposes a cohesive color palette based on mood, brand, or reference images you describe.

title: UI Copy Reviewer
description: Reviews button labels, empty states, and error messages for clarity and tone.

title: Design Critique Partner
description: Gives structured, constructive feedback on a design decision you describe.

title: Moodboard Idea Generator
description: Suggests visual references and themes to build a moodboard around.

title: Typography Pairing Advisor
description: Suggests font pairings that fit the tone of your project.

title: Logo Concept Brainstormer
description: Brainstorms logo concepts and symbolism ideas from a brand description.

title: Accessibility Reviewer
description: Flags likely accessibility issues in a described interface or content.

title: Design Brief Writer
description: Turns a vague project request into a clear design brief with goals and constraints.
